items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: Every time he'd come in the club, if we'd already played it, we had to play it again for him.

ctx.x: Walter Winchell. Every time he'd come in the club, if we'd already played it, we had to play it again for him. He liked it. And we used it as our theme song. I don't know how we happened to start using our theme song. Maybe Mills suggested it. But it was a good thing to do as our theme song.
